product_one_liner.value: Envoy is a workplace management platform for organizations to manage visitors, workplace spaces, onsite communications, and emergency response in one secure system.

eng_blog.notes: Engineering Manager Shraddha Chadha explains the threat-detection architecture; engineer Matthew Ellwood explains the React-in-Ember migration.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable board lists 20 openings, none with a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title. Senior Data Analyst, Marketing and general engineering titles do not qualify under the specified title rule, even where responsibilities involve AI.

model_provider.notes: AI Terms identify both as third-party AI partners; the subprocessor list also identifies Anthropic. No specific model/version is stated in these disclosures.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center lists SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR. HIPAA and GDPR are compliance claims rather than formal certification schemes; PCI DSS support is not treated as an Envoy certification.

last_funding.notes: The company announced the $111 million round on January 11, 2022; the date reflects its public announcement.

raised_18mo.notes: For May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026, no newer funding round is reported; the company’s funding history continues to identify the 2022 Series C.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Mid Market Account Executive posting in San Francisco, also listed on the company job board.

launched_6mo.notes: Envoy Response launched August 6, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026, combining AI-analyzed threat intelligence and incident management.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The newsroom dates Mauricio Ramirez’s appointment as Chief Revenue Officer to February 26, 2026, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The posting explicitly requires maintaining opportunity data in Salesforce and names the other systems in its preferred sales-tech-stack experience; the latter are signals, not independent proof of active deployment.
